newsitem.title: UK: INSTANT VIEW - UK jobless data, average earnings.
newsitem.headline: INSTANT VIEW - UK jobless data, average earnings.

text.p: Following is a selection of analysts' comments on data showing the UK June unemployment rate at 5.7 percent and average earnings rising 4.25 pct in May -
KEITH EDMONDS, CHIEF ANALYST, IBJ INTERNATIONAL
"It's really a case of more of the same - the labour market continues to get tighter and yet there is no sign that average earnings is picking up."
TIM FOX, INTERNATIONAL ECONOMIST AT STANDARD CHARTERED

"The balance on all the numbers apart from the average earnings numbers was on the disappointing side. Obviously the fall in unemployment is good but that does risk, further out, that the continuation of labour market tightness will exert upward pressure on average earnings."
